note: List prices for estimation only. excludes: Time-billed cache storage (Google charges 4.50 per 1M tokens per hour). No usage field reports cache residency time, so it is never included in an estimate from this table.
Cache-write (cache-creation) tokens. No usage field reports them, so their cost component is unavailable rather than zero.
OpenAI Batch, Flex, Fast-mode and long-context tiers; only Standard short context is recorded.

models.caveat: Output rates include thinking tokens. The pricing page does not state the cached-token convention; it is taken from the API usage documentation quoted in usageConventionQuote (promptTokenCount includes cachedContentTokenCount), so the full-rate input term subtracts cached tokens on that DECLARED basis. Cache storage is time-billed and never included in an estimate.

models.usageConventionQuote: usageMetadata.promptTokenCount includes cachedContentTokenCount; output is candidatesTokenCount; thoughtsTokenCount is reported separately and the pricing page states the output price includes thinking tokens.
models.reasoningNote: DECLARED convention: output is charged on candidatesTokenCount PLUS thoughtsTokenCount, because the pricing page states the output price includes thinking tokens and thoughts are reported separately. Estimates using it are labelled.
